newsitem.title: CHINA: Itochu Corp, NGK in China deal.
newsitem.headline: Itochu Corp, NGK in China deal.

text.p: Japan's NGK Insulators Ltd and trading house Itochu Corp have signed an agreement to set up a $25 million joint venture plant producing suspension insulators in northern China, the China Daily newspaper said on Tuesday.
The NGK Insulators Tangshan Co in northern Hebei province would be set up with Tangshan High Voltage Insulators Works, which would own a five percent stake in the new firm, it said.
NGK Insulators would control 76 percent and Itochu would own 19 percent of the venture, which was expected to achieve annual sales of $30 million by 1999, the newspaper said.
Production would begin in 1998, with annual output to reach 1.8 million units of suspension insulators used in electricity transmission lines, it said but gave no further details.

China's rapidly expanding power industry augered well for he joint venture, with total electricity generating capacity expected to grow by around 80,000 megawatts over the next five years, it quoted the governor of Hebei province Ye Liansong as saying.
